rules.condition: At a write clock edge where i_wr_en = 1 and o_full = 0
rules.statement: The write is accepted; the storage array and the write Gray pointer both update at that same write edge.

rules.condition: i_wr_en sampled at a write edge while o_full = 1
rules.statement: The write is dropped with write pointer and storage unchanged, and o_overflow pulses for one write cycle.

rules.condition: i_rd_en sampled at a read edge while o_empty = 1
rules.statement: The read is rejected with read pointer and storage unchanged, and o_underflow pulses for one read cycle.
o_overflow and o_underflow are registered, one cycle wide, and return to 0 by themselves.

rules.condition: After a write to an empty FIFO
rules.statement: o_rd_data shows the new word (show-ahead) before o_empty falls, because the storage is read every cycle with the next read pointer address.
o_rd_data moves to the next word right after the read edge without extra latency.

rules.condition: After the write pointer is first captured by the read domain
rules.statement: o_empty falls S read edges after the first capturing edge of the write pointer, combinationally from the synchronized pointer.

rules.condition: After the first read from a full FIFO
rules.statement: o_full falls late, after the read pointer crosses to the write domain, not at the read edge.
Neither o_empty nor o_full may be early; flags are pessimistic.

rules.condition: Write to an empty FIFO at the entry addressed by the read pointer
rules.statement: o_rd_data keeps the old word until the next read edge, which captures the new word while o_empty is still 1.
i_wr_en, i_wr_data and i_rd_en change only at rising edges of their respective clocks.
Both storage configurations give the same waveforms at every port, and the macro returns the old word when read and write of the same address occur at the same edge.
The testbench ignores o_rd_data while o_empty = 1.
o_rd_data is never X when a read is accepted.

rules.condition: Metastability model enabled, a bit changes at the input of the last stage
rules.statement: Each synchronized bit independently gets a seed-chosen extra delay of 0, 1 or 2 destination cycles.
The model output equals the plain chain output.

rules.condition: Input changes again while a change is pending
rules.statement: The pending value is replaced by the new input value and the delay restarts.
Different bits of the same signal can get different delays.
The replacement can make a short pulse disappear on the model output.

rules.condition: With the metastability model, a bit arrives late
rules.statement: FIFO flags stay pessimistic, delayed S, S+1 or S+2 destination edges after the first capturing edge.
The metastability model is controlled by +AFIFO_MSYNC_EN (enable) and +AFIFO_MSYNC_SEED (seed).
